interpretive_note: An item of the reporting annex of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999. Unlike the plan-content and progress-report items, the corpus supplies no provision from which the actor bound by this annex item could be reconstructed: Annex VI and its chapeau are absent. The attribution could therefore be established only from an external source, which codebook section 6 makes a ground of exclusion rather than of inference. The item itself is an assessment, hence an object.
additional_context_required: Point (c) of Annex VI to Regulation (EU) 2018/1999, and its chapeau identifying the actor bound by the reporting item, are not reproduced in the corpus.
Article 15 of Regulation (EU) 2018/1999 is referred to but only its amended paragraph 1 and point 3(c) are reproduced in the corpus.
